source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.1, data build 995, released 2026-10-16

data.summary:
A model told to move as close as possible to a model or unit ends in base contact with it if its move is long enough without breaking another restriction, such as **coherency**, and otherwise gets as near as it can. One already as close as it can get stays put but still counts as making the move.

Told to move as close as possible to an **objective**, it ends in range of it if the move allows without breaking another restriction, and otherwise gets as near as it can. One already in range may move up to that move’s maximum distance, as long as it ends still in range.
